transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess what finally made me come in is that I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to make time for things I cared about—painting, hiking, choir, Sunday family gatherings—and now even when I have a free hour, I mostly just sit there. I can’t seem to care about any of it.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or enjoyment in activities like painting, hiking, choir, or spending time with family?

Yes. That’s a big part of why I’m here. I used to really enjoy painting and hiking, and I’d go to choir and family gatherings without even thinking about it. Now, even if I have the time, I just… don’t want to do any of it. I’ll just sit there, and I can’t seem to make myself care.
Do you feel sad or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes. Most days it feels like there’s this heavy gray film over everything. I can be in the classroom with students or at home with my husband, and I still feel hollow… like I’m close to crying a lot of the time.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have you experienced these symptoms almost every day during that time?
It’s been going on for about eight months now. It kind of started building after I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative. And yes… during that time, it’s been almost every day.
Do you notice that your mood is worse at a particular time of day, like in the morning when you first wake up?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern, like mornings being definitely worse. It’s more that the low mood is just kind of there most of the day.
Have you noticed a change in your energy levels or do you feel more fatigued than usual, even if you haven’t been doing much physically?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel worn down a lot, but I haven’t paid close enough attention to say it’s a clear change in my energy. It’s just… I don’t feel like myself most days.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you’re not good enough, even about things you wouldn’t have worried about before?

Yes. Especially with the curriculum project. If anything goes wrong, even something small, I start thinking I’m letting the students down. And then I get this feeling like I’m wasting everything my parents sacrificed for me to have this kind of opportunity.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed a big change either way. My appetite maybe varies day to day, but I don’t think I’ve been eating much more or less than usual, and I haven’t noticed my weight changing.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still lately?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower, and I don’t feel especially restless or like I can’t sit still.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or had thoughts about harming yourself?

Yes… I have had thoughts like that. Not exactly that I want to do something to myself, but late at night in the studio I sometimes think it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t made any plan, but it scares me. I did tell my husband because I felt like I couldn’t keep handling those thoughts by myself.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having anything quite like this before, at least not to this extent. I’ve had rough periods, like anyone, but this feels different.
Have you ever had a period lasting several weeks or more where you felt down or lost interest in things, even before this current time?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of a time before this where it lasted for weeks like that. I’ve had stressful or low periods, but nothing that stands out the same way.
Looking back on your life, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more, even before this current period started?
I really don’t think so. I’ve had times where I was stressed or sad, but I can’t remember anything before this that lasted a couple of weeks or more in the same way.
Looking back further, can you recall any time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a few weeks?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve been trying to think back, but I really can’t recall a time before this where it went on for more than a few weeks like that.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
Not that I can remember, no. I’ve had rough times before, but I don’t think anything lasted more than two weeks like this.
